code_source_policy: input_commit identifies the historical mathematical source. source_id and source_sha256 identify the files as supplied in namespace_input_commit, including earlier documented adaptations. Current public derivatives rename paths, format labels and descriptive identifiers; algorithms and mathematical conditions are preserved.

publication_sanitization.note: Public derivatives redact local paths in diagnostics only; original private audit inputs remain in research history. Mathematical observations unchanged.

release_wording_update.note: Release-facing descriptions and two saved-witness docstrings were revised; the README PDF and hash inventory were regenerated. Executable statements, schemas, evidence, numerical claims and third-party files were unchanged.

public_namespace.name: schema-check
public_namespace.source_identifier_policy: source is a public logical name within namespace_input_commit, not a package-relative path; source_id and source_sha256 identify its input bytes, including earlier documented adaptations. path, sha256 and bytes identify the distributed derivative. Private original paths are retained outside this package.
public_namespace.evidence_policy: Format labels are renamed together in producers, checkers and saved certificates. Byte-certificate digests, schemas, numeric observations, token graphs and upstream snapshots are unchanged.

component_documentation_update.note: Component release-status wording and task history were revised. Current specification and trust boundaries were retained; dated history was collected in docs/VERIFICATION-RECORD.md. Mathematical payloads and original source digests were unchanged.

component_output_update.note: Bundled v1 example outputs, test report and temporary test files were moved under .cache/. Test assertions and mathematical payloads were unchanged; original source digests were retained.
